---
title: Margin caption attribute in formats without a margin column
format:
  beamer:
    # write the .tex only, no PDF compile
    output-ext: tex
  revealjs: default
  dashboard: default
_quarto:
  tests:
    beamer:
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        -
          # the caption stays an ordinary caption (`.` stands for a backslash)
          - '.caption\{.label\{fig-a\}Figure caption text\}'
        -
          - 'sidecaption'
          - 'sidenotes'
      printsMessage:
        level: INFO
        regex: "Caption location 'margin' is not supported in beamer output"
    revealjs:
      ensureHtmlElements:
        -
          - 'figcaption.quarto-float-caption-bottom'
        -
          - '.quarto-float-caption-margin'
          - '.margin-caption'
    dashboard:
      ensureHtmlElements:
        -
          - 'figcaption.quarto-float-fig.quarto-float-caption-bottom'
          - 'figcaption.quarto-float-tbl.quarto-float-caption-bottom'
        -
          - '.quarto-float-caption-margin'
          - '.margin-caption'
---

A `cap-location="margin"` attribute on a single float, with no document-level `cap-location`, gets the same bottom-caption fallback as the document option in formats without a margin column.

## Row

::: {#fig-a cap-location="margin"}
Figure content.

Figure caption text
:::

::: {#tbl-a cap-location="margin"}
| a | b |
|---|---|
| 1 | 2 |

Table caption text
:::
